scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres minio minio-init
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.gen:api: cd apps/api && uv run python -c "import json;from app.main import app;print(json.dumps(app.openapi(),indent=2))" > ../web/src/lib/api/openapi.json && bun run --cwd ../web openapi-typescript src/lib/api/openapi.json -o src/lib/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd apps/web lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
